title: COMPUTATIONAL IMAGING
description: Computational imaging uses a combination of novel imaging optics and a computational module to produce new forms of visual information. Survey of the state-of-the-art in computational imaging. Review of recent papers on omnidirectional and panoramic imaging, catadioptric imaging, high dynamic range imaging, mosaicing and superresolution. Classes are seminars with the instructor, guest speakers, and students presenting papers and discussing them
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( COMS W4731 ) or COMS W4731 ; or instructor's permission.
